rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a human mother.

example.english: Mother cooked my favorite dish today.
example.traditional: 媽媽今日煮咗我最鍾意食嘅菜。
example.jyutping: maa1 maa1 gam1 jat6 zyu2 zo2 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 ge3 coi3

rows.note: Use this colloquial form especially when referring to your own or someone else's mother in family speech.

example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 ngo5 faan1 lai4 laa3

rows.note: Use this more formal term in writing or formal speech rather than the everyday family words.

example.english: On Mother's Day, the school pays tribute to every mother.
example.traditional: 母親節，學校向所有母親致敬。
example.jyutping: mou5 can1 zit3 hok6 haau6 hoeng3 so2 jau5 mou5 can1 zi3 ging3

rows.note: Use this for a woman who is pregnant, especially in medical or informative contexts.

example.english: This mother-to-be needs regular prenatal checkups.
example.traditional: 呢位孕婦要定期做產檢。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 jan6 fu5 jiu3 ding6 kei4 zou6 caan2 gim2
